question: Pick the most accurate one-word substitute for “official criticism or stern disapproval.”
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3 i.e. Censure**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"official criticism or stern disapproval"** refers to expressing strong disapproval or condemnation, especially in an authoritative or formal manner. (आधिकारिक आलोचना या कड़ी अस्वीकृति)
 
• **"Censure"** means to officially criticize or express disapproval of someone or something, often in a formal context. (निंदा करना)
 
 
• **Example:** The board issued a strong censure against the employee for violating company policies.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3 i.e. Censure**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Accusation** (आरोप): A charge or claim that someone has done something illegal or wrong.

 
 
• **Example:** The accusation of theft was dismissed due to a lack of evidence.
 
 
 
• **Reproof** (डांट): An expression of blame or disapproval.
 
 
• **Example:** His teacher's reproof was enough to make him realize his mistake.
 
 
 
• **Indictment** (आरोप पत्र): A formal charge or accusation of a serious crime.
 
 
• **Example:** The indictment against the politician led to a lengthy trial.
